purpose: High-confidence A-priority mass insertion across compiled MDI assets, preserving the Stage39U renderer/font baseline.

strategy.narrow: Exact-case English source + matching ptr/Num/Max metadata -> relocate Korean UTF-8 into trailing-zero stream padding and repoint metadata. Original source/key bytes remain untouched.
strategy.utf16: Unique case-insensitive English match. If ptr/Num/Max metadata exists, relocate proper Korean UTF-16. Otherwise patch only when the original field plus adjacent UTF-16 NUL padding fits.
strategy.allocator: Only trailing all-zero padding inside existing decoded MDI stream lengths; no stream growth and no overwrite of nonzero data.
